description.value: Fresh Air is Kelowna's established multi-sport shop specializing in bikes, running, skiing, and snowboarding, carrying a broad range of bikes from road and gravel to full-suspension MTB, junior, and electric models. The shop offers dedicated cycling services including bike fitting, rentals, and bike service and assessment, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan. Their accessories inventory — including bags and panniers, locks, tubes, lights, and tools — covers many on-tour essentials.
